*   **Time Complexity:** Rendering is accelerated by empty space skipping, reducing the number of samples per ray.
The evaluation of multiple small MLPs is faster than a single large MLP.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Storage is significantly reduced compared to per-frame models.
*   **When to Use:** Real-time volumetric video playback where storage and training time are constraints.
*   **When Not to Use:** Scenes with extremely fine, high-frequency details that the hash table and MLP map resolution cannot capture.
It is designed to represent volumetric videos efficiently, addressing the limitations of storing per-frame neural radiance fields.

The method builds on [Empty Space Skipping via Data Structures](5619-empty-space-skipping-via-data-structures.md) by using an occupancy volume to skip empty space, and on [Space Leaping](5863-space-leaping.md) by using a grid-based structure for acceleration.
